assertion_results.description: omnifocus-data skill-run signal file was written
omnifocus-data skill-run did not end in failure
The canonical OmniFocus data file exists after the skill ran
The pull reported status:available rather than failed. This is the assertion that surfaces the five consecutive degraded boots of September 2026, where OmniFocus silently contributed zero data.

Every task carries an explicit completed field. This guard exists so that assertion 006 cannot pass vacuously: if the field is dropped from the output shape, the leak check would have nothing to match against and would silently pass.

No completed task leaked into the pull. The inbox permanently holds roughly 247 completed tasks alongside ~8 incomplete ones, and OmniFocus Clean Up does NOT remove them, so the completed is false filter must live in the query itself. Any completed:true here means the filter was dropped.
The pull wrote a numeric task_count, so downstream consumers can distinguish an empty pull from a missing one
The extraction script is present. Regression guard: the script, not prose, is what enforces the completed filter and the status contract.
